acquisition_method.evidence: The Orbitrap was operated in data-dependent mode (DDA), automatically switching between MS and MS/MS acquisition, with a m/z range of 350–1500.

cleavage_agent.evidence: In brief, samples were reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin.

collision_energy.evidence: Dependent mass spectra were generated for up to 20 precursors after fragmentation using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at a normalized collision energy of 30% and a resolution of 15,000 after accumulation to the set target value of 100% (1e5) for a maximum of 22ms.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Dependent mass spectra were generated for up to 20 precursors after fragmentation using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at a normalized collision energy of 30% and a resolution of 15,000 after accumulation to the set target value of 100% (1e5) for a maximum of 22ms.

instrument.evidence: Nano-flow LC-MS/MS was performed by coupling an Easy-nLC 1200 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) to an Orbitrap Exploris mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Quantitative normalized ratios were calculated by MaxQuant and subsequently analyzed with Perseus and STRING.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Full scan spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap at 60,000 resolution after accumulation to the set target value of 300% (100% = 1e6) and maximum injection time of 45 ms.

ptm.evidence: The search parameters included: carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues as fixed modifications, acetyl (protein N-term), oxidation (M), and deamidation (Q, N) as variable modifications.
